title: Community questions and sharing
intro: Prepare a question or a useful experience for someone you trust. Read reviewed community information here when it becomes available.
status: Lift is not receiving community submissions yet. Nothing you write here is sent to Lift or published.
kind: What would you like to prepare?
question: A question
placeholder: For example: What should I ask before paying a housing deposit?
safety: Leave out names, phone numbers, document numbers, exact addresses and details identifying another person. Please do not name agents or employers.
privacy: Your draft stays only in this open page. Reloading or clearing removes it, even if plan saving is on. Text you copy, download or share remains outside Lift.
draftNote: This is a personal question or experience, not verified information. It has not been reviewed or published by Lift.
empty: Write a question or experience first.
tooLong: Please keep your draft within 1,200 characters.
shareHelp: You choose the app and recipient. Sharing does not submit a draft to Lift and does not make it a reviewed community post.
fallback: Sharing is unavailable. You can copy or download your draft instead.
copied: Draft copied. You choose where to paste it.
copyFailed: Copying is unavailable. You can download your draft instead.
cleared: Your draft was cleared from this page.
noPosts: There are no reviewed community posts yet. Personal drafts are never added automatically.
reviewExplain: Before publication, a person must check the wording, remove identifying details and check sources. Legal and health information also needs a qualified reviewer. Experiences must be labelled as experiences.
stale: Review is overdue. Check the original source before relying on this post.
experienceLabel: Personal experience — may not apply to you
notEmergency: This page is not monitored and cannot provide urgent help. Use a support service directly when you need assistance.
